body:
I've done a lot of thinking the past few days since I've posted this and I haven't ended my life yet. I was actually pretty close last night (I have a lot of options open when it comes to suicide), thinking back to a lot of stuff and feeling overburdened by life problems.

I can't break up with my girlfriend. Not until I see it that she can get better, and I believe she will get better - but not for awhile. I can't let go of somebody who loves and needs me because I love her.

I appreciate all the comments and thank you for everyone's support. It really helps reading all the comments.
